config.retention: forever: no DBOS workflow retention or garbage collection is configured
config.executor_id: local (DBOS default); every worker recovers the PENDING workflows of executor local at launch
config.takeover: a new worker re-enqueues and runs PENDING workflows at DBOS.launch, with no timeout
config.owner_timeout_s: 30 (T-N request timeout); the owner is also asked at once when the T-N child workflow is dead-lettered on recovery
